name: Goldie Fenn
perk: Goldie gives you 10% off tools and buildings
lines: Need anything, dear? The store's always open.
Tobias used to grow strawberries like rubies. Just saying.
You're a natural. Don't let it go to your head.
I put a little something aside for you. Kidding! Mostly.
Honestly, the valley feels alive again. That's you, you know.
I told Tobias you're doing wonderfully. He wrote back with three exclamation marks.
You're family now. I don't say that to everyone. I say it to most people, but I mean it with you.
When the market's full again, the first pie is yours.

events.title: The pie debt
lines: Sit down, sit down. I've got something to confess.
Tobias said I owe him a pie. I do. From 1987. I lost a bet about whether it would rain on Harvest Day.
It didn't rain. It snowed. In August. Technically we were both wrong.
So I've baked the pie. Thirty-odd years late. Would you take it to him next time you write?
...You can have a slice first. It's a big pie.

events.title: Closing time
lines: The store's quiet tonight. I like it like this.
When my Henry passed, I kept the store open every day. Couldn't bear the quiet.
Then the valley emptied out and the quiet came anyway.
But now there's mud on my floor again. Farmers tracking in, asking for seeds.
It's the best mess I've had in years. Thank you, dear.

name: Bruno Okafor
lines: Measure twice, cut once. My father said that. He was always late.
Need something built? I'm your man.
That fence of yours is holding up nicely. Good posts.
Corn makes the best bread. Fight me. Politely.
I carved a little sign for your gate. It's not done. It'll be done.
Rufus smiled at me yesterday. I think. Hard to tell with the beard.
You know what I like about you? You finish things.
Whatever this valley needs next, count me in.

events.title: The sign
lines: Here. It's finished. Took me a while.
It's a sign for your gate. Carved the name in oak. Your farm needs a name, you know.
I left it blank in the middle. Wasn't my place to choose.
...Don't look at me like that. I'm not getting sentimental. It's sawdust in my eyes.

events.title: My father's chisel
lines: This chisel was my father's. He built half of Bramblewick with it.
When the young folk left, he stopped building. Said there was no one left to build for.
I kept making things anyway. Fences nobody needed. Benches nobody sat on.
Now I've got a waiting list. A waiting list! He'd have laughed.
I want you to have the first bench I made. It's crooked. It's the best one.

name: Rufus Hale
perk: Rufus mills faster for you: the mill gets a free extra slot
lines: Hmph.
Don't track mud in the mill.
Wheat's looking decent. Decent. Don't make a thing of it.
Twenty years that wheel sat still. Don't make me wait twenty more for good wheat.
...Thank you. For the mill. There. I said it.
Tobias and I used to race grain carts down that hill. I won. He says he won. He's wrong.
You can call me Ru. Nobody calls me Ru. Don't call me Ru in front of Bruno.
Bring me flour sacks and I'll tell you stories. Short ones.

events.title: Grain cart race
lines: Sit. I'm going to tell you a story. A short one.
Your great-uncle and I raced grain carts down Mill Hill. Every summer. Ten years running.
I won six times. He says he won six times. That's twelve, which is impossible. So he's lying.
...He let me win the last one. I knew he did. I never told him I knew.
Don't you tell him either.

events.title: The millstone
lines: See that mark on the millstone? My daughter carved it when she was six. Her initials.
She lives in the city now. Calls on Sundays. Says the valley's too quiet.
I wrote to her last week. Told her the wheel's turning again. Told her about you.
She's coming to visit. First time in eight years.
...Make sure there's good wheat that week. I want her to see what this place can be.

name: Pip Rowan
perk: Pip shares her tricks: your bakery works 25% faster
lines: Sorry! I mean, hello. I always start with sorry.
Is it too early to be thinking about pie? It's never too early.
I tried a new recipe and only burned half of it. Progress!
Your wheat smells like summer. Is that weird to say? It's weird.
I saved you the crispy end. Everyone wants the crispy end. You get it.
Goldie says I worry too much. I worry that's true.
You're my favourite customer. Don't tell the others. Actually, they know.
When I'm nervous now, I think about your farm. All those neat little rows.

events.title: The burnt batch
lines: Don't look! Don't look at the oven!
I tried to make Goldie's birthday cake and it's... it's charcoal. It's a charcoal cake.
Her party's in an hour. I'm going to have to move to another valley. Do you know any nice valleys?
Wait. You brought strawberries? We could... we could do a strawberry shortcake. No oven needed!
You're a genius. I'm a genius. We're geniuses. Hand me that bowl.

events.title: Pip's secret
lines: Can I tell you something? I almost didn't open the bakery again.
I had my bags packed. Bus ticket and everything. No flour, no customers, no point.
Then Rufus knocked on my door with a sack of your flour. Rufus! He doesn't knock on anyone's door.
He said, 'Someone's working hard up there. Least you can do is bake.'
So I unpacked. And now look. I have a pink stall and a waiting list and a friend. That's you. You're the friend.

name: Ziggy Marlowe
perk: Ziggy gives you a friend's price: 10% off his cart
lines: Everything on this cart has a story. Some of them are even true!
Rare seeds, dear farmer. Rarer than an honest merchant. Present company excepted.
You again! My favourite face in the valley. Don't tell Goldie.
I once sold a pumpkin to a king. A small king. A king of a very small hill.
Between you and me, the gold nuggets come from a river. A very specific river. I'll never tell.
Bramblewick was a ghost town when I first rolled through. Look at it now.
I don't usually stay anywhere long. I might make an exception for this place.
For you, the secret stock. There is no secret stock. Or is there.

events.title: A real treasure
lines: Ah, a private viewing! Come, come. I show this to no one.
This is a compass. It doesn't point north. It points to wherever I'm needed next.
Every three days it points to Bramblewick. Most towns, it points once and never again.
...Alright, it's a regular compass. It's broken. But the story's true in spirit!

events.title: The end of the road
lines: Can I be honest with you? Properly honest? It doesn't come naturally.
I've been rolling this cart for twenty years. Never stayed anywhere longer than a night.
Moving's easier. Nobody expects anything from someone who's always leaving.
But Bramblewick... Goldie saves me a pie. Juniper named a gadget after me. You ask how I've been.
I might rent the old shop by the square. Just for winters. Don't tell anyone. Especially me.

name: Dr. Hazel Quill
perk: Hazel shares her notes: +10% XP from every harvest
lines: Brassica, solanum, cucurbita. I'm not showing off. I'm labelling.
Please don't touch the specimens. Those are specimens. That's lunch.
Your soil pH is excellent. That's the nicest thing I know how to say.
Tobias and I argued about tomatoes for forty years. I was right. Don't ask him.
I've started a page in the Almanac just for your farm. Don't let it go to your head.
I used to think plants were easier than people. You're making me reconsider. Slightly.
You notice things. Most people don't notice anything. It's very restful, talking to you.
When I'm gone, the Almanac is yours. Not soon. I'm extremely healthy. I just mean eventually.

events.title: The jam stains
lines: I've been restoring the almanac. Look at this. Look at all this jam.
Tobias always ate toast while he wrote. Strawberry jam, every page.
I used to find it unbearable. Unscientific. Sticky.
Now I'm leaving the stains in. They're part of the record. Don't tell him.

events.title: The last specimen
lines: This seed is the last one Tobias sent me before he left. Forty years ago. I never planted it.
I told myself I was waiting for the right soil. The right conditions.
The truth is, planting it meant admitting he wasn't coming back.
But he is coming back. You did that. So I'd like you to plant it.
Whatever grows, I'll draw it on the first page.

name: Juniper & Moss
perk: Moss digs up two finds a day instead of one
lines: Moss says hi! He says it a lot. It's mostly hi.
I'm inventing a machine that invents machines. It's going great. It's on fire, but great.
Can Moss sleep in your field? He likes the carrot smell. He's already asleep in your field.
Hazel says I ask too many questions. Is that a question? Asking for me.
I made you a badge. It says FARMER. I spelled it right this time!
Moss dug up your old boot. He thinks it's treasure. It's kind of treasure.
You're my best friend. Moss's too. We voted. It was unanimous. Moss voted twice.
When I grow up I'm going to invent a farm that farms itself. But you can still visit.

events.title: Moss's birthday
lines: It's Moss's birthday! Well, it's the day I found him. Same thing.
He was in a box by the mill. Tiny. Cold. Rufus pretended he didn't see me take him home.
Rufus brings him a biscuit every week. He thinks I don't know. I know.
Anyway! Moss wants a carrot cake. Pip's making one. You're invited. Moss says you have to come. He's very bossy for a dog.

events.title: The real invention
lines: Can I show you my best invention ever? It's not a machine.
It's a map. Of Bramblewick. I drew everyone on it.
Goldie in the store. Rufus at the mill. Pip at her stall. Ziggy's cart, which moves, so I drew wheels.
And here's you, in the middle. Because everything started with you.
Moss is next to you. He insisted.
